description: Upload a file or image to a record's field. Takes the file's content in base64. Saves the file and attaches it to the given field. For multiple-file fields it adds to the existing files.

field_name.description: Name or ID of the file/image field

file_content.description: The file's content encoded in base64

file_name.description: File name with extension, for example 'invoice.pdf' or 'photo.jpg'

record_id.description: ID of the record to attach the file to

name: upload_file_to_record
